paper_description: Constructing high quality datasets for training and evaluating deepfake detection models, including WildDeepFake and IDForge.
Enhancing deepfake detection accuracy and generalization via uncertainty-aware learning and multimodal identity reference-assisted detection.
Developing efficient robustness adversarial evaluation approaches, including transfer-based and cross-modal attacks for multimedia models.
Investigating unrestricted adversarial attacks using diffusion models to alter few pixels for attack on video and vision-language models.
Introducing Reliable and Efficient Concept Erasure (RECE) for removing unsafe concepts in diffusion models without fine-tuning.
Developing Dual encoder Modulation network (DuMo) for precise erasure of inappropriate target concepts with minimum impairment.
Focusing on AI-generated content identification and Offensive and Non-compliant Content Attribution for responsible generative AI.
Applying AI to health, including FoodLMM for food domain, weight prediction from food logs, and diet suggestion generation.
